commit.message:
fix(motion): eliminate full-width cuts at ring merges

Collapse interior Clipper lattice micro-steps (`< 5e-5` mm) in ring
walks before `share_ends` so segment tangents stay stable at ring
joins.

Extend `ring_fill` to recursive binary sub-bands up to `RING = 16` that
fill both uncovered ring gaps and remaining full-width flanks in Inside
or Outside order, keeping gap reach at `1 * tool_r`, expanding hit cusp
reach to `2 * tool_r`, and extending boundary pieces within `3.5 *
tool_r` to `c`'s outer boundary.

Guard `level_order::edge_route` and `ring_links::edge_route` chords
against walking along flanks where both `0.9 * r` sides cut uncut stock.

Pin `fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` at 0 full-width
points, `fig8_inside_offset_names_each_full_width_cut` at 0 off-wall
points and 0 narrow notes, and add
`one_ring_set::two_lobe_ring_merge_cuts_no_full_width_at_waist`.

Changelog: Fix full-width cuts where offset rings of two lobes merge (#3788)
Fixes #3788
